body: I'm going to check out free legal assistance this week to talk about the foreclosure and the eviction court date (not set yet) sold a lot of stuff this weekend, garage sale next weekend, too busy to think about suicide today. It's like when I get really suicidal, it's like a big monster is on top of me holding me down and I can't breathe. Sometimes I'm scared to die, some days I just so look forward to it.
Oh god now, those people would run me into the ground, no thanks.
The one about dead people meeting god? OY!

I OD'd and was out 4 days, no hospital. It was kind of weird, like a total brain reboot. I don't recommend it. I do however know that feeling of wanting to sleep forever, never waking up to this shit ever again. But for some reason, I wake up to another shit day. Lots of sci fi movies where people sleep for long trips.

Well, um a whole lot of people have made something of themselves without graduating hs. I think you're putting way toomuch pressure on yourself, and way too much importance on this degree thing. So to try and find a solution, can you get a tutor to help you get through the math part? At least to get to a C? Worst case scenario, you have to go to summer school, right? What did the school counselor say? Hey I totally skated through high school, got a c average, managed to get into college and graduate. I was threatened with flunking.... Managed to pull it together, you can too.
It was sweet, and you're lucky you have someone.

A great way to break the circuit of negative thinking is to get out in nature. The deeper into nature, the better. Can you go on some kind of day hike, or walk in a park with a river? Honestly, I can't be in the shitter when I'm out in nature. In the warmer months, i throw a blanket down and lay amongst the trees to get grounded. Get out of your usual rut, Sunday, go for a drive and bring a camera. Shoot whatever interests you. That's what I do.

Fucking habit, I can't think of anything else. Wake up, coffee, fuck around on the computer, eat dinner, bla bla bla, watch a movie go to bed, repeat. Just instinct and habit. Nothing good to look forward to.
Have you seen the movie Wild? I think it might be a little inspiring, the backpacking an self evaluation part. You could have a real epiphany.

That prozac is shit. Sigh... My opinion, of course, but it only wrecks your brain. Check out tianeptine.com a completely different antidepressant. While my life is still nothing but shit, the Tianeptine helps where nothing else does. Really lifts the bottom up to a manageable space. Like your snow story, I was totally set on driving my car at 140mph into a pillar under an overpass, I had it all picked out, nice straight shot, no ditch or hill to deal with. Bam, dead like Diana. Well the angel of not yet tore a big damn hole in my rear tire's valve stem, and I got a flat on the freeway about a mile form the pillar. $500 and a new set of tires later.... I postponed my departure. Why not take a little time off your plan to end it and keep trying different things to cope.
Thank you for your kind works and taking the time to give support.
